messages.subject: Sentinel - internal investigation report (privileged)
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Draft internal investigation report attached for your review before it goes to the Board. Headline: the tongue-actuated interlock failed, and the function test due ~October 2025 was missed - last recorded test March 2025. Proximate cause the interlock; underlying causes the maintenance-testing lapse and over-reliance on operator behaviour. I've kept it firmly within privilege.

This is the document that, more than anything, we must not let leak to the HSE. Thoughts?

Tom

messages.subject: RE: Sentinel - internal investigation report (privileged)
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

Good and appropriately frank. Two points: (1) make crystal clear on the face of it that it's prepared for the purpose of legal advice and keep distribution to the named group only; (2) the missed October test is our biggest culpability exposure - we need to be ready to frame it as a maintenance lapse on a single machine, not a systemic failure. That framing runs through everything. Let's not share the root-cause analysis beyond Richard and the Board.

Sarah

--
